lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice sequencing a short past story with först, sedan, and till slut.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A colleague describes a small weekend errand that had several steps.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Telling events in a clear order.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about going into town for errands, lunch, and a relaxed ending to the day.

main_focus.name: sequencing past events
main_focus.description: Use simple time connectors to organize a short past-tense story.
model_examples: Till slut tog jag en fika.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use sequencing words naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: basic modal verbs: kan, vill, ska
one simple reason clause with för att or därför att

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use sequencing chunks to make the story easy to follow.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks what happened during the weekend.
dialogue_shape.middle: A short sequence unfolds with three clear steps.
dialogue_shape.ending: The conversation ends with a reaction to how the day felt.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat sequence markers in a natural narrative order

focus: what happens first in the story

sentence_focus: one sentence starting with Till slut
one sentence about an errand in town
one sentence describing how the day felt afterward
